ESourceResidual.common_two_flag_cost_tendsto.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] {V : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] {ι : Type u_3}
  (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] H)
  (e : HilbertBasis ι ℂ ↥(OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta)ᗮ) (u v : ℕ → H)
  (hc : Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun p =>
      ∑' (j : ℕ),
        ‖u j‖ *
          ‖v j - (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan e0 eF Theta p.1).starProjection (v j) -
              (ESourceResidual.finiteComplementSpan (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta) (⇑e) p.2).starProjection
                (v j)‖)
    (Filter.atTop ×ˢ Filter.atTop) (nhds 0)
'ESourceResidual.common_two_flag_cost_tendsto' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Q.NuclearSourceCutoff.source_residual_nuclearNorm_tendsto.{w, u_1} {H κ : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] {V : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] H) (A M : H →L[ℂ] H) (u v : κ → H)
  (hc : Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖) (hfactor : ∀ (x : H), HasSum (fun j => inner ℂ (u j) x • v j) (A (M x))) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun T =>
      Masullo.NuclearFactorization.nuclearNorm
        (((1 - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection).comp A).comp M -
          ((1 - (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan e0 eF Theta T).starProjection).comp A).comp M))
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

ESourceResidual.common_source_nuclearNorm_finite_certificate.{w, u_1} {H κ : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] {V : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] H) (A M : H →L[ℂ] H) (u v : κ → H)
  (hc : Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖) (hfactor : ∀ (x : H), HasSum (fun j => inner ℂ (u j) x • v j) (A (M x)))
  (T : Finset H) (C : Submodule ℂ H) [C.HasOrthogonalProjection] (hCS : C ≤ (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta)ᗮ)
  (J : Finset κ) :
  Masullo.NuclearFactorization.nuclearNorm
      (((1 - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection).comp A).comp M -
        ((1 - (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan e0 eF Theta T).starProjection).comp A).comp M) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal
      (∑ j ∈ J,
          ‖u j‖ *
            ‖v j - (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan e0 eF Theta T).starProjection (v j) -
                C.starProjection (v j)‖ +
        ∑' (j : { j // j ∉ J }), ‖u ↑j‖ * ‖v ↑j‖)
